clue.text: Answer is again wrong

parts.note: re- is the prefix meaning again
a tort is a civil wrong in law

explanation.surface: Someone insists that a reply is once more incorrect.
explanation.definitionFit: A retort is a sharp reply, a synonym for an answer given back.

clue.text: Rising employment included a brother of Jacob

indicators.note: included tells us the letter from 'a' sits inside the turned word
in a down clue rising means the word for employment is read from the bottom up

parts.note: employment means use

explanation.surface: A biblical brother finds his job prospects improving.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rising' turns USE into ESU, and 'included' puts A inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis Esau is the elder twin brother of Jacob, who tricks him out of his birthright.

clue.text: Started keeping goal for an indefinite duration

indicators.note: keeping means holding something inside, so the word for started surrounds the goal

parts.note: started means opened, as a shop opens
a goal is an end, as in the end in view

explanation.surface: A goalkeeper began a match that seemed to go on forever.
explanation.walkthrough: 'goal' and 'keeping' conjure a football keeper, but 'keeping' is the container signal and 'goal' an aim.
explanation.definitionFit: Something open-ended has no fixed limit or finishing point, so it runs on indefinitely.

clue.text: Ships could be drifters

definitions.meaning: cargo vessels without a fixed route are called tramp ships
vagrants who drift from place to place

explanation.definitionFit: Tramps are both cargo ships taking work where they find it and homeless wanderers.

clue.text: About to get severe cramp

parts.note: re means about or concerning, as in business letters
severe means strict

explanation.surface: Someone is about to suffer a painful muscle spasm.
explanation.definitionFit: To cramp is to hamper or confine, a synonym of restrict.

clue.text: Knight to bring up topic for discussion

definitions.meaning: to knight is to elevate a subject of the monarch to a higher rank
to introduce a matter into conversation

explanation.walkthrough: A knight is a subject of the Crown raised in rank, so the phrase read literally means to knight.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to introduce a topic; read literally it means promoting one of the monarch's subjects.

clue.text: A bird's last lay

parts.note: read literally, the final song of a swan, which legend says sings only as it dies

explanation.definitionFit: A swansong is a final performance or work, from the legend of the dying swan singing.

clue.text: Up and down, round and round it goes

indicators.note: in a down clue, the word reads the same whether read upwards or downwards

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Something spins endlessly, rising and falling as it turns.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Up and down' says the answer reads the same either way in the grid.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotor is the rotating part of a machine, such as a helicopter's blades, spinning continuously.

clue.text: Cost in café outrageous — get takeaway

indicators.note: outrageous suggests wild disorder, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Prices at a café are outrageous, so buy a takeaway instead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'takeaway' looks like a food order but is read as the verb take away; 'get' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To confiscate is to seize or take away someone's property by authority.

clue.text: Classic form of transport involving air and steam

indicators.note: involving in the sense of entangling or mixing together, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A vintage vehicle powered by air and steam.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involving' rearranges AIR and STEAM; 'steam' hints at a steam train, but the answer is a car.
explanation.definitionFit: A Maserati is an Italian sports car, many of whose older models are classics.

clue.text: Wait on nondrinker, whose after a tip

indicators.note: after places the nondrinker's letters behind the a

parts.note: TT stands for teetotal, a nondrinker
a tip is an end

explanation.surface: A waiter who does not drink hopes for a gratuity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'whose' stands for the setter's 'who's' (who is), so the nondrinker comes after 'a'; TT, short for teetotal, is a standard crossword nondrinker.
explanation.definitionFit: To attend someone is to wait on or serve them, as a servant does.

clue.text: It travels fast, say the attendants

parts.note: to express is to say or put into words
a train is a retinue of attendants following a dignitary

explanation.surface: Servants report how quickly something moves.
explanation.definitionFit: An express train is a fast service making few stops.

clue.text: Religious student, one smitten with Goliath

indicators.note: smitten means struck, so the letters are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone studying scripture, like David, struck down the giant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'smitten' rearranges ONE and GOLIATH; the surface recalls David smiting Goliath.
explanation.definitionFit: A theologian studies religion and the nature of God.

clue.text: Discarded garden tools may be kept here

definitions.meaning: cast off, as a snake loses its skin

definitions.text: garden tools may be kept here

explanation.definitionFit: Shed is both the past tense of a verb meaning cast off and a garden storage hut.

clue.text: Be reluctant to suspend a footballer

parts.note: to suspend is to hang
a back is a defending player in football

explanation.surface: A club is unwilling to ban one of its players.
explanation.definitionFit: To hang back is to hesitate or hold back out of reluctance.

clue.text: Judges assess criterion

parts.note: the bench means judges collectively
to mark is to assess, as a teacher grades work

explanation.definitionFit: A benchmark is a standard against which others are measured, a criterion.

clue.text: A piece for brass and wind instruments

parts.note: a horn is a brass instrument
a pipe is a wind instrument

explanation.surface: A composition scored for a band of brass and woodwind.
explanation.definitionFit: A hornpipe is a lively dance and the piece of music for it, associated with sailors.

clue.text: Selfish drivers do go rash when given the run-around

indicators.note: being given the run-around means being sent all over the place, so the letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: Inconsiderate motorists behave recklessly when messed about.
explanation.definitionFit: Road hogs are drivers who selfishly take more than their share of the road.

clue.text: Where cricketers practise catches

definitions.meaning: netted practice pitches used for batting and bowling practice

explanation.definitionFit: Nets are cricket practice areas enclosed by netting, and to net is to catch.

clue.text: Fastened securely, but escaped

definitions.meaning: ran off suddenly, as a horse does

explanation.definitionFit: Bolted means secured with a bolt, and also ran away suddenly.

clue.text: Official crossing place

parts.note: not a pedestrian crossing but the booth where a voter marks a cross on a ballot paper

explanation.definitionFit: Voters mark their ballot with a cross in this booth at an official election station.

clue.text: Learning about one in the French department

indicators.note: about means going round, so the word for learning encloses the one

parts.note: lore is learning or traditional knowledge
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A scholar travels to work in a French ministry.
explanation.definitionFit: Loire is a French department named after the river that flows through it.

clue.text: Opening for a machine operator

parts.note: read as the gap a user drops a coin into to work a machine, not a job vacancy

explanation.definitionFit: A slot is a narrow opening, such as the coin slot that operates a vending machine.

clue.text: Tempers lost when prime minister discovers Italian resort

indicators.note: lost tells us the letters of tempers vanish from the rearranged words that follow

explanation.surface: A leader keeps losing their temper on discovering an Italian seaside town.
explanation.walkthrough: Take the letters of TEMPERS out of PRIME MINISTER and rearrange the remaining R, I, M, I, N, I.
explanation.definitionFit: Rimini is a seaside resort on Italy's Adriatic coast.

clue.text: What's inside isn't real — only different

indicators.note: different means changed, so the letters are put in another order

explanation.surface: Something hidden within is fake, just altered.
explanation.definitionFit: Entrails are the internal organs, literally what lies inside a body.

clue.text: The inner workings are essential

parts.note: describes a quality that is built in and belongs to the very nature of a thing

explanation.definitionFit: Something inherent exists as an essential, intrinsic part of the thing itself.

clue.text: Knock out some facts about aircraft

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the facts go round the knockout

parts.note: data are facts and figures
KO is the boxing abbreviation for knockout

explanation.surface: A boxer's knockout statistics are gathered about a plane.
explanation.definitionFit: The Douglas Dakota was a twin-engined transport aircraft widely used in the Second World War.
